env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

env CGO_ENABLED=

[cgo] ! logos build .
[cgo] stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\] cgo is disabled'
[cgo] ! logos build ./sub
[cgo] stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\] cgo is disabled'
[cgo] go build -o $WORK/plainsub$GOEXE ./sub
[cgo] exec $WORK/plainsub$GOEXE
[cgo] stdout '^sub: 42$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/cgodefault

go 1.27

-- main.lgo --
package main

/*
int answer() { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("default:", C.answer()) }

-- sub/main.go --
package main

/*
int answer() { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("sub:", C.answer()) }
